method: Native serialized GLB FLOAT tracks sampled using glTF LINEAR/slerp; all vertices of every primitive skinned using the original inverse binds and WEIGHTS_0. No floor projection or runtime adjustment. Fixed bind offsets and limb lengths checked independently. C1 bridges use actual serialized idle/run tracks at eight cycle phases and displayed endpoint velocities.
scope: Surface and seam measurements are independent of motion-qa-v1. Bridge C0/C1 is mathematical helper validation. Bridge skin-floor residuals are reported separately: the helper supplies local-pose continuity, and consuming world-space IK must preserve planted feet. No game code or phone hardware was exercised.
